author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the past, there was something called LISP machine. It is a special CPU proposed built to run LISP code

In the age of AI, every software is rewritten in Rust. We should build a Rust machine, a special CPU proposed built to run Rust code

Let me pitch this idea to Lisa.
